returnPolicies.description: You have 30 days from the day your item is delivered to open a return request. The countdown starts at delivery, not at purchase, so an item still in transit is never counted against your window.
items: The exact deadline for each item is shown on its return screen as "Return until".
If the delivery date is corrected, the deadline moves with it.
Once the window closes the purchase is final and a return can no longer be opened.

returnPolicies.header: Reasons You Can Return An Item
returnPolicies.description: A return request has to state one of the following reasons:
items: Damaged or defective — the item arrived broken, incomplete, or does not work.
Not as described — the item differs meaningfully from the listing's description or photos.
Wrong item received — what arrived is not the item you ordered.
Other — anything the three reasons above do not cover. Explain it in the description so the seller can respond.

returnPolicies.header: What To Include In Your Request
returnPolicies.description: The more specific your request, the faster a seller can act on it. Every request asks for:
items: A description of the problem, in your own words.
The condition of the item: unopened in its original packaging, opened, or lightly used.
Photos — up to 5. For damage or a wrong item, photos are the single thing most likely to get a request accepted quickly.
Whether you are asking for a refund or a replacement.

returnPolicies.description: You choose how the item travels back to the seller when you open the request:
items: Prepaid return label — you print a label and drop the parcel off yourself.
Courier pickup — a courier collects the parcel from your address.
Return the item in the condition you described, with the original packaging, accessories and documentation you received.
The return shipping fee matches what delivery of that item cost you. It is deducted from your refund, and shown on the return screen before you confirm.

returnPolicies.description: Your request goes straight to the seller and stays pending until they respond. There are three possible outcomes:
items: Refund — the seller accepts and the refund amount is shown on your return screen.
Replacement — the seller sends a replacement item instead of refunding you.
Rejected — the seller declines the request and can leave a message explaining why.
You can reopen the return screen at any time to see the current status and the seller's message.

returnPolicies.description: Listings marked Final Sale at the time of purchase cannot be returned or refunded, and no return option appears for them. Check for the Final Sale label before you buy — it is shown on the listing.
